lex:
ἀ-δόκιμος, -ον,
[in LXX: Pro.25:4, Isa.1:22 (סִיג) * ;]
__1. of things (prop. of metals: LXX, ll. with), not standing the test, rejected: γῆ, Heb.6:8.
__2. Of persons, rejected after testing, reprobate: Rom.1:28, 1Co.9:27, 2Co.13:5-7, 2Ti.3:8, Tit.1:16 (Cremer, 212).
†

strongs.def: unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally)
strongs.from: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1384 (δόκιμος)
